seo_need.buyer_research: Mixed, leaning to online research at the evaluation stage. The motion is referral- and CFO-network-led (CEO-led sales, testimonials, peer referrals), but buyers clearly research online: a r/venturecapital thread titled 'Fund Admin recs?
